body:
Here is the example of project, where we started to implement the i18n feature on top of Links Notation 
- http://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind

We should use as dependencies:
- https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation
- https://github.com/link-foundation/lino-objects-codec
- https://github.com/link-foundation/lino-arguments (for CLI)

We should have cli converters, that convert code and data from 
- https://www.i18next.com
- https://www.npmjs.com/package/i18n-js
- https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-intl

We also support all the best features that users expect from such libraries, but on Public Domain, we also need detailed table of comparision, so we know exactly how we will compare, to have ultimate plan to have all the best features.

We also should support all the same in Rust, with macro that compiles i18n from files at compile time.

For Rust version we should use all the best practices from https://github.com/link-foundation/rust-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template

As the result we should get rust and js folders in root of repositories, and also rust.yml and js.yml in workflows.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in a single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Make 0.0.1 version of universal i18n library, that uses Links Notation instead of any other format
